technique_name: Design an interface that allows users to order sandwiches from a deli.
description: The interface for ordering sandwiches from a deli should be intuitive, easy to use and should provide visual cues to guide users throughout the process. The main page should list all sandwich options and include appropriate images to give users an idea of what they are ordering. A selection bar should be provided that allows users to customize the size, toppings and condiments on their sandwiches.
